thread:
simon: quick note — saw flaky client messages hitting customers when route fallback kicks in. sometimes we return 502+text, other times 200 with partial output. we should decide on a single consumer-visible taxonomy.

laura: ugh. do we have examples?

ken: saw a few: one case was `status: 200, body: {partial: true, note: \"degraded model used\"}` and another `status: 502, body: {error: \"backend_timeout\"}`. same user, same request. confusing.

maria: this is because routing code maps internal errors -> different surface strategies: degrade-with-200 vs hard-fail. mixture depends on route policy.

pm_asha: product ask: customers want predictable contract. if we sometimes 200-with-warning, sometimes 5xx, integrations break. prefer one canonical client-facing signal and console badging.

laura: agree. proposal: two top-level client-visible buckets: `OK_WITH_DEGRADATION` (200) and `FAIL_RETRYABLE` (5xx). plus `FAIL_NON_RETRY` (4xx). each gets a stable `client_reason` string for SDKs/console.

ken: +1. we also need a small set of machine-readable header hints for routing fallback metrics. suggestion: `x-rw-client-reason: OK_WITH_DEGRADATION|FAIL_RETRYABLE|FAIL_NON_RETRY` and `x-rw-route-hint: primary->fallback`

maria: implementational note: internal error taxonomy stays richer (`KV_CACHE_MISS`, `MODEL_CRASH`, `TIMEOUT`, `QUOTA_EXCEEDED`) but map to those 3 client buckets at the gateway. keep mapping table in repo.

simon: example mapping snippet: 
```json
{
  "MODEL_CRASH": "FAIL_RETRYABLE",
  "TIMEOUT": "FAIL_RETRYABLE",
  "QUOTA_EXCEEDED": "FAIL_NON_RETRY",
  "DEGRADED_RESPONSE": "OK_WITH_DEGRADATION"
}
```

pm_asha: console needs to show exact internal tag somewhere (for support) but not as the primary client message. maybe `details.internal_code` in the debug pane, and `client_reason` for apps.

laura: UX: console badge labels: green `OK` with a small yellow dot `degraded` tooltip for `OK_WITH_DEGRADATION`; amber `retryable failure` for `FAIL_RETRYABLE`; red `blocked` for `FAIL_NON_RETRY`. dashboards can filter by internal tags.

ken: telemetry: we must emit both the mapped client bucket and the original internal code in traces/metrics: `client_bucket=OK_WITH_DEGRADATION`, `internal_error=TIMEOUT`. that preserves signal for lb/infra.

maria: agree — important for capacity planning. also ensure we count `OK_WITH_DEGRADATION` separately in SLOs (latency vs quality).

simon: question: do we want to return 200 + `client_reason` field for `OK_WITH_DEGRADATION` or use 202? product wants 200. keep 200.

pm_asha: keep 200. apps expect it. but strongly encourage `client_reason` header + body field so SDKs can surface a warning.

ken: short JSON example for responses: 
```json
// degraded
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
x-rw-client-reason: OK_WITH_DEGRADATION
x-rw-route-hint: primary->fallback
{
  "output": "...",
  "client_reason": "OK_WITH_DEGRADATION",
  "note": "model fallback used; some quality loss"
}
// hard-fail
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
x-rw-client-reason: FAIL_RETRYABLE
{
  "error": "FAIL_RETRYABLE",
  "message": "temporary service degradation, retryable"
}
```

maria: ops question: how will quota errors map? `QUOTA_EXCEEDED` -> `FAIL_NON_RETRY` (429). ensure SDKs don't auto-retry.

laura: also need migration plan: current SDKs may parse body for heuristics. we should ship a short deprecation notice and 3-step rollout: 1) gateway emits headers + body field alongside current behavior, 2) console docs + SDK patch to surface `client_reason`, 3) start returning canonical responses and remove legacy variants after 6 weeks.

pm_asha: timeline sounds reasonable. add a small runbook for customer-facing incidents when we flip behavior.

ci-bot: deploy pipeline check — new header addition will require updating API contract tests and the e2e mock servers. flagged tests: `sdk-integration`, `console-badging`.

ken: good catch. i'll add tests. final outstanding: exact naming for `client_reason` variants? we used `OK_WITH_DEGRADATION`, `FAIL_RETRYABLE`, `FAIL_NON_RETRY`. any objections?

maria: i prefer `DEGRADED_OK` shorter. but fine if we keep the explicit ones. pick one and lock it.

simon: prefer explicit. locking these three today unless someone objects by EOD.

pm_asha: +1. please open RFC PR with mapping table, sample responses, SDK checklist and rollout timeline.

laura: i'll add console badge specs and tooltips to the PR.

ken: will add gateway mapping + tests.

maria: will add metrics and trace tags.

simon: thanks all — filing PR now. :rocket:
